title: Threshold as a real quotient
statement: Let $n,a,d,s$ be positive integers with $2a\le d$ and $s\ge1$. Let $\varepsilon=a/d$, and let $M=\max\{1,\lceil4s^2/\varepsilon\rceil\}$. The threshold $\varepsilon/(4M)$, viewed as a real number, equals $\varepsilon/(4M)$.
